## Architecture check

Guides applied: `commits-and-prs.md`, `api-dtos-and-validation.md`, `best-practices.md`, `module-structure.md`, `testing.md`, `remarks.md`.

- `package.json:65` — Splitting a change: one PR carries a dependency bump, a supply-chain-gate policy change, and feature work in two unrelated modules (`safe-shield` recipient analysis, `transactions` settings mapper), which the guide lists as too large on two counts ("mixes a dependency bump with feature work", "changes more than one module for reasons that are not a single mechanical consequence").
- `.yarnrc.yml:18` — No scope creep: `npmPreapprovedPackages: ['@safe-global/*']` is a standing, repo-wide exemption from the 7-day `npmMinimalAgeGate` for every in-house package, broader than the single `safe-deployments` bump requires and not a consequence of recognising Safe 1.5.0.
- PR title — Linking: the title carries `(WA-2921)`, and squash-merge makes it a permanent commit subject with an issue reference the guide reserves for the body (0 of the last 400 subjects on `main` do this).
- `src/modules/transactions/routes/mappers/common/settings-change.mapper.spec.ts:308` — R-008 (Tests that assert the framework, not the behavior): asserts `SETTINGS_CHANGE_METHODS` contains the literal the same diff just added to it, already implied by the two mapper tests above it.

**Verdict:** ❌ 4 finding(s)
